pages.title: Gingerbread Man with Wavy Icing Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling gingerbread man spreads his arms on this printable coloring page, with three round buttons and wavy icing bands around his wrists and ankles.

pages.title: Easy Gingerbread Man Waving Hello Coloring Page
pages.description: A waving gingerbread man fills this printable coloring page, drawn with a bold smooth outline, two round buttons, and wide open spaces for coloring.

pages.title: Cute Gingerbread Man with Heart Buttons Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute gingerbread man clasps his hands under his chin on this printable coloring page, with two heart buttons, wavy icing, and three outlined stars.

pages.title: Blank Gingerbread Man Cookie Outline Coloring Page
pages.description: The blank gingerbread man on this printable coloring page has a round head, outstretched arms, and a smooth cookie outline enclosing one open area.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man with a Santa Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Two snowflakes flank the gingerbread man on this printable coloring page as he smiles beneath a Santa hat with a pompom and scalloped brim.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Holding a Candy Cane Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man holds a tall striped candy cane on this printable coloring page, wearing a small bow tie with three outlined stars around him.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man with Gumdrop Buttons Coloring Page
pages.description: Three gumdrop buttons run down the front of the gingerbread man on this printable coloring page, with wavy icing on his forehead and wrists.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Wearing a Bow Tie Coloring Page
pages.description: An oversized bow tie sits beneath the smiling face of this gingerbread man, who lifts one arm among three snowflakes on the printable coloring page.

pages.title: Gingerbread Girl in an Icing Dress Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread girl wears a layered dress on this printable coloring page, with scalloped icing along the skirt, a head bow, and two floating hearts.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man and Girl Holding Hands Coloring Page
pages.description: Under a large heart on this printable coloring page, a gingerbread man in a bow tie holds hands with a gingerbread girl in an icing dress.

pages.title: Gingerbread Family Standing Together Coloring Page
pages.description: Three gingerbread cookies form a family portrait on this printable coloring page, with two taller figures behind a small cookie wearing a bow tie.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man with a Bite Missing Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a smiling gingerbread man wearing a bow tie, with a bite missing from one foot and two crumbs beside it.

pages.title: Gingerbread Cookies on a Baking Tray Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, three gingerbread cookies lie on a rimmed baking tray, decorated with a bow tie, a heart, and a snowflake.

pages.title: Gingerbread Cookies in a Cookie Jar Coloring Page
pages.description: Two gingerbread cookies smile inside a lidded cookie jar on this printable coloring page, while another stands in front wearing a bow tie and icing cuffs.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Cookie Cutter and Rolling Pin Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man cookie cutter sits on a sheet of dough on this printable coloring page, with a wood-grain rolling pin lying diagonally nearby.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Decorating Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man in a chef's hat pipes icing onto a star cookie beside a tree cookie on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man by a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, a gingerbread man raises one arm beside a Christmas tree decorated with round ornaments and a star on top.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man in a Mug of Hot Cocoa Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling gingerbread man peeks out of a steaming mug of cocoa among chunky marshmallows, wearing a bow tie on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Gingerbread Pair Inside a Snow Globe Coloring Page
pages.description: Two gingerbread figures stand beneath falling snowflakes inside a snow globe on this printable coloring page, with a ribbon bow decorating the base.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Tangled in Christmas Lights Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a gingerbread man with both arms raised while a string of Christmas bulbs loops across his chest and trails below.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Gliding on Ice Skates Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man balances on one skate with arms spread wide, one foot lifted, and curved skate tracks below on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Wearing a Winter Scarf Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man wears a striped scarf with tasseled ends while two snowflakes frame his smiling face on this printable coloring page.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man in a Candy Mandala Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling gingerbread man fills the center of this printable coloring page, framed by a circular pattern of candy canes, stars, and gumdrops.

pages.title: Gingerbread Cookie and Candy Pattern Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page repeats gingerbread figures in rows, with candy canes, star cookies, and swirled peppermint candies tucked into the spaces between them.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Jumps Out of the Oven Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man leaps from an open oven on this printable coloring page, with an empty baking tray inside and curved motion lines behind him.

pages.title: Gingerbread Man Runs Past a Cow and a Horse Coloring Page
pages.description: A gingerbread man races along a curving path on this printable coloring page while a spotted cow and a horse watch from behind a fence.
